final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM `order` GROUP BY account_id), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) as total FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.account_id, s1.cnt, CAST(s1.cnt AS REAL) / s2.total as ratio FROM step1 s1 CROSS JOIN step2 s2), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s3.account_id, s3.cnt, s3.ratio, s3.ratio - s4.avg_ratio as diff FROM step3 s3 CROSS JOIN step4 s4 WHERE s3.ratio > s4.avg_ratio) SELECT SUM(cnt) as sum_cnt, AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio, AVG(diff) as avg_diff FROM step5
